test_title: PYST 2: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 02 Aug, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined words in the given sentence.**

The principal posted all the staff rules __in__ __black and white__.
solution:
The correct answer is: **in writing**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The phrase "**in black and white**" is an idiomatic expression that means something is put in writing, typically in a clear and straightforward manner. (लिखित में)
